name: @sharedid-edge/module-encrypted-ip
description: SharedID Edge module (opt-in): the client's IP address encrypted (HPKE) to Google's key for Google Publisher Tag's publisher-provided IP, and to Prebid Server hosts' keys

sharedidEdge.name: encrypted-ip
sharedidEdge.title: the client IP, encrypted for Google Publisher Tag and Prebid Server
sharedidEdge.summary: `eip`: the visitor's IP address encrypted (HPKE) to each configured recipient's public key: `google` for `googletag.setConfig({ ipAddress })`, and `pbs` by Prebid Server host (experimental); nothing when consent rules it out. Not an ID, and readable only by its recipient
sharedidEdge.settings: `google`, `pbs` (by host): each `key` (unless a scheduled snapshot provides it) and `keyFetched`
